verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents its own exports of operational data in open formats: OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP, and A2A traffic, and logs that can be analyzed in any OpenTelemetry tool. Its kongctl CLI also supports declarative configuration for managing resources as code, which suggests configuration is held in a portable form. However, no documented 'export all data' or offboarding capability covers configuration, entities, and history together. missing for 10: an explicit full-data export/offboarding feature, documented export of configuration and entities (models, providers, policies) to an open format, a statement on data completeness and retention when leaving, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: AI Gateway can export OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP, and A2A traffic through an OpenTelemetry AI Policy.
You can gather logs and metrics then analyze these using Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool.
It supports two modes of operation: declarative configuration for managing resources as code, and imperative commands for one-off operations and inspection.
